nodes.v: The Candidacy
Do I need dental implants?

Are you missing one or more of your teeth? Regular brushing, flossing, and preventive checkups allow some people to maintain their natural smiles for a lifetime. However, sometimes our teeth just can't stand up to the everyday wear and tear we put on them.

Tooth loss can be caused by oral trauma due to an accident, illness, stress, age, decay, and more. Sometimes it's just bad luck that causes someone to suffer the loss of a tooth. If you want to know more, Dr. Will Sung and his team are there to help at Grand Mission Dentistry, Richmond, TX.

nodes.v: You've been told elsewhere that you're not a candidate — get a free second opinion
Check if I'm a candidate
Preliminary procedures
Sometimes the site has to be prepared first
After your consultation, Dr. Sung may recommend one of these before the implant goes in. It isn't a setback — it's what makes the implant last.
Bone graft
Rebuilds jawbone that has shrunk away since the tooth was lost, so the implant has something solid to anchor into.
Socket preservation
Done at the time of extraction. Fills and protects the socket so the bone holds its shape while it heals.
Gum tissue regeneration
Restores the gum around the site, which is what gives the finished crown a natural margin instead of a visible line.
Ridge augmentation
Widens or heightens a jaw ridge that has flattened, usually after a tooth has been missing for a long time.
